mechanism.collision_property: If a base has appeared fewer than 16 times in TRAIN, early VALIDATION occurrences continue through suffixes not yet used for that base until all 16 have been exhausted. Exact-surface reuse is therefore avoided whenever it is avoidable under the fixed K=16 inventory.
mechanism.cycle_property: Within every consecutive block of 16 occurrences of the same encoded base, each of the 16 suffix variants is used exactly once.
mechanism.name: recurrence_avoiding_surface_allocation
mechanism.per_base_variant_permutation: For each encoded lexical base and seed, deterministically order the 16 inherited suffix indices by stable hash over namespace, seed, serialized encoded base, and suffix index.
mechanism.train_allocation: Process TRAIN lines in ascending line index and tokens left-to-right. For each encoded base, occurrence number n receives permutation[n mod 16].
mechanism.validation_allocation: Freeze the final TRAIN occurrence count for each encoded base. Process VALIDATION lines in ascending line index and tokens left-to-right, continuing that base's occurrence counter from the TRAIN count. No validation look-ahead is permitted.

lineage_requirements: exact inherited TRAIN-fitted monoalphabetic base mapping
exact inherited 16-glyph master suffix inventory and order
exactly one suffix glyph appended to every TRAIN/VALIDATION token
